authority: draft for council review; no model or real-data authority
numerical_runtime: Explicit .tools/venv/bin/python, CPython 3.11.11, executable path/digest and sys.flags.optimize=0 in every new output; non-zero optimization refused. source .tools/activate for Go 1.26.10. Bare python is not pinned; no toolchain pin change.
zero_variance_rule: Two-pass centered residual variance and repository aggregation ordering identical after explicit float64 rounding in Go; zero-SE pivot is 0 iff abs(Dstar-Dhat)<=1e-14, otherwise signed infinity, complete and vertex paths. Heterogeneous-T inexact-ratio differential and main.fit disassembly accompany revision 7.
keyed_order_strings: For runs/audit/dev keys, repository is exact UTF-8 case-preserved owner/name: django/django, microsoft/TypeScript, prometheus/prometheus, fastapi/fastapi, tokio-rs/axum. Commit SHA and run ID are full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit SHA; issue ID is exact UTF-8 Scout issue ID. Messages use NUL separators as preregistered.

method_selection.predeclared_rule: X1-R3-01(c): any L400 diagnostic block pooled one-sided Wilson MC95 lower > .025 selects studentized, otherwise percentile; fixed before outcomes

size_dependence_definition: subtract a*(N-min_eligible_size)/(max_eligible_size-min_eligible_size); min/max span all eligible runs in all three locked repositories, one offset per size; zero when size range zero
size_dependence_choice: requested coverage includes .20 diagnostic stress; calibrated references and safety retain {0,.05} for feasible power. Earlier .05 timing is author-recorded, not independently verified.

populations.maximum_attempts_per_population: ceil(4000/p_gate); estimate p_gate at inventory from 100000 keyed size-only SRS redraws; zero means not testable
populations.counter_rule: Gate rejection performs no audit/bootstrap. Every gate-passing execution, including inadequate, consumes the execution cap; attempts include both rejections and executions. Either exhaustion before 2000 eligible trials makes the population/cell/row unmeasured and failed.
populations.sizes: complete eligible-run size vectors from the locked inventory, not the selected sample alone
populations.seed_message: UTF-8 canonical compact sorted-key cell JSON NUL population-index NUL attempt-index NUL phase
populations.seed_conversion: first 64 big-endian bits of HMAC-SHA-256; indices zero-based
populations.trial_sequence: attempt-index increases monotonically, without outcome-dependent reseeding
populations.safety_identity: dimensions unresolved_kappa and critical_share (j axis tag, derived probability separate); profile includes both, interval-group omits critical_share; construction base excludes both axes
populations.criticality_identity: canonical-criticality phase includes critical_share j; masks and bootstrap omit j

eligibility.sampling_gates: at least 1000 sampled units per repository; at most 60000 sampled units overall; original 20-to-2000 per-run eligibility
eligibility.adequacy: protocol retrieval quality, at least 60 known-positive audit labels per repository, weighted unknown share at most .05, and at most .05 omitted bootstrap replicates
required_reporting: gate-passing trial execution count including inadequacy
inadequate conditional on gates pass count and Wilson MC95
eligibility.cap_exhaustion: unmeasured; cell and row fail closed
eligibility.sampling_gate_estimate: 100000 keyed SRS redraws of locked eligible sizes only; report successes, p_gate and Wilson MC95; no models/outcomes. Separately cap attempts at ceil(4000/p_gate) and trial executions at 4000 including inadequacy; remeasure cheap gate CPU and expensive trial CPU separately before dev.

coverage_gate.applies_to: every complete-label coverage cell and every missing-label cell in each M row, including both rank structures, scanner populations and size-dependence levels

calibrated_power_and_null.profiles: M x prevalence x gain_sd x overlap x failure x rank_structure x size_dependence; scanner control false, canonical safety clear
calibrated_power_and_null.calibration: One fixed-key construction; exact ordered-IEEE754 transitions for the original rounding expression per unique (P,k,global size offset), at most 601136 candidates (<2^20); <=20 truth-only index evaluations then one final frame. Exact returned _population_gain(prepared, latent_gain)==realised_gain(frame) or refuse. Truth/materialised and optimised/full-frame-oracle fixtures span caps 400/850, sizes>=500, failure .02, overlap .5, prevalence .1/.55, size factors .05/.20, gradient, scanner controls and heterogeneity .1, plus reduced-L benchmark profile. Fresh-construction equality is determinism, not independent regeneration. Retain <=0 null/smallest attainable >=.10/.20; disclose target/realised/excess and unreachable unmeasured.
calibrated_power_and_null.enumeration_cost: Benchmark every size 20 through 2000, prevalence .55 and size factor .05; charge measured worst-case enumeration CPU separately for each of 11900 calibrated populations. No new candidate cache or three-size per-unit enumeration extrapolation.
calibrated_power_and_null.unreachable_target: power-infeasible or null-unmeasured; row fails, never relabel requested gain as realised gain
calibrated_power_and_null.requested_latent_rows: descriptive reachability only; cannot substitute for calibrated power/null

missing_label_grid.mask: independently within each repository, among sampled audit rows use uniform keys within the mechanism's eligible d groups; select whole rows without exceeding weighted budget u*sum(1/pi); skip overweight boundary rows; record actual share, target shortfall and maximum weight quantum
missing_label_grid.target_shortfall_rule: if eligible mechanism mass cannot reach target to one maximum-weight quantum, cell is unmeasured, not silently a smaller missingness cell
missing_label_grid.canonical_state: masked rows have truth cannot_tell (unknown Y); alternate independent seeded invalid-session and adjudicated-cannot_tell provenance, with criticality unknown; apply safety() to census union and vertex envelope to audit rows
missing_label_grid.grid_reduction: none; complete grid retained and included in compute projection

final_safety_OC.scope: explicit descriptive boundary grid, never a reduction or prerequisite of binding coverage/reference/missing gates
final_safety_OC.counter_rule: Stop at 2000 gate-passing executions including inadequacy. The 4000 execution cap is inert for safety, retained only as a guard; same sampling-attempt cap, rejection does no audit/bootstrap. Attempt exhaustion before 2000 gate-passing trials is unmeasured.
final_safety_OC.denominator: gate-passing trials, including retrieval-inadequate and safety-unknown outcomes; no exclusion of adverse canonical labels
final_safety_OC.interval_reuse: common unknown-Y masks and bootstrap draws across the four critical shares; critical labels change safety only, so retrieval interval reuse is exact
final_safety_OC.reachability: same one construction, <=20 truth-only search evaluations and one final frame; smallest attainable >=.10/.20 or <=0 null; unreachable profiles unmeasured
final_safety_OC.unresolved_rate: kappa/Mbar; Mbar expected sampled below-floor count from locked eligible sizes
final_safety_OC.critical_positive_share: min(1,j/TPbar_below); expected sampled true positives below floor computed per synthetic population before outer outcomes; zero TPbar gives c=0 and report degenerate axis
final_safety_OC.construction_reuse: 336*5 fixed-key populations shared across 24 canonical states; one optimised calibration (<=20 truth searches and one final frame) plus 24 canonical-state materialisations, not 24 constructions
final_safety_OC.schedule: After all binding rows, remaining capacity only; cannot gate dev/test or change verdict. Before the first safety output, freeze ascending HMAC-SHA-256 order with UTF-8 key `169-x1-safety-order` over the canonical `safety-interval-group` identity; run the canonical-criticality phase per group in that same order, with no reordering after the first output. The descriptive-safety scheduling policy (start, worker allocation, pauses and termination) is frozen with the reviewed stage-3 OC controller before the first safety output; none of these may depend on partial or completed safety outcomes, and every pause or termination is recorded with its cause. A group is measured only when all five populations reach the 2,000 stop. Attempt exhaustion retains “unmeasured; cell fails”. At gold freeze, every unstarted or unfinished group is “not completed by gold”, a separate status from trial-level safety-unmeasured: report counts, show partial counts separately and exclude them from pooled Wilson summaries.
final_safety_OC.canonical_generation: assign independent per-case Bernoulli unresolved/critical states in each frozen synthetic population before outer outcomes, using common unknown-Y keys across critical shares; unresolved events split invalid final sessions versus canonical cannot_tell with truth/criticality unknown; otherwise truth is Y and critical=yes only among true positives
final_safety_OC.analysis: apply safety() to canonical census labels; unknown audit Y enters missing share and vertices; no independent veto/unresolved flag substitution
final_safety_OC.coverage_duplication: none; safety settings do not multiply coverage cells or precision

row_timing.before_dev: compute every M row; at least one must pass complete and missing coverage, calibrated power and null, trial eligibility and compute limits; otherwise not testable before dev models
row_timing.after_dev: no registered row <=Mhat means not testable/no test calls; otherwise largest M<=Mhat must already have passed, no skipping failed nearest row

resources.parallel_projection_assumption: eight dedicated workers within observed 18 physical cores; measured-input projection with 2x overhead, not a measured eight-worker full-grid run
resources.binding_resource_stop_rule: Binding resource stop rule: Binding construction, calibration and enumeration, requested-base evaluation, binding trials and binding gate checks, all ×2, must fit 2,880 core-hours and 15 OC wall days. Workers are fixed at 8, with no reduction. Locked memory fit is 8 × max(locked-size peak RSS of construction, calibration, and trial worker plus helper), using the existing lifetime high-water method, ≤ hw.memsize − 8 GiB (60,129,542,144 bytes on this host). Failed or unmeasured CPU or memory fit means not testable before dev. Locked remeasurement is one create-once run, on the host that will run the binding OC (record hw.model, hw.memsize, logical CPU count and OS build), of the reviewed benchmark and calibration commands with the revision-7 replicate structure (README benchmark invocation `--method studentized --trials 2000 --cores 8` with its cell set and one/two-worker equality; the calibration-overhead command's per-population measurements and worst-case enumeration), changing only the size source to the locked sizes; that size input is the only permitted code change and is reviewed under rule 5. Record load averages and concurrent-process count in provenance. Rerun only after a recorded integrity failure: a crash not caused by resource exhaustion, a closure mismatch, or a host fault evidenced by a contemporaneous OS-recorded malfunction independent of observed timings or partial results; record the reason and preserve that evidence and the interrupted run's available output. A resource-exhaustion crash is a failed fit. Operator termination and host load are not integrity failures; a run terminated without a qualifying integrity failure leaves the fit unmeasured. A failed fit never permits a rerun. Report every completed run; each binding input is the maximum over all completed runs.
resources.attempt_and_execution_projection: Measured gate CPU times ceil(4000/p_gate), separately from maximum trial CPU times 4000 binding or 2000 safety executions/population including inadequacy, all times 2. Binding resource stop rule is below; total fit plans safety only. Gold status follows final_safety_OC.schedule.

calibration_projection.cell_components: 1792 references plus 252 missing, with 336 additional safety profiles; 11900 calibrated populations total
calibration_projection.cost: Construction CPU/unit, truth-search/final-frame CPU/unit excluding enumeration, worst-case enumeration CPU/population, canonical-state CPU/unit, cheap gate attempts and hard-bounded expensive trials; all with 2x overhead

measured_prepreparation_projection.supersedes: Revision 7 reserve-free planning memory fit superseded by fixed 8 GiB reserve. Preserve revision 6 safety overcharge/total-gate projection and earlier outputs.
measured_prepreparation_projection.interpretation: Arithmetic-only revision-8 projection from unchanged revision-7 benchmark/calibration; fixed 8 GiB reserve, linear memory extrapolation, not locked max-phase fit or stage authority.
measured_prepreparation_projection.locked_runtime_and_memory_gate: Apply resources.binding_resource_stop_rule; safety cannot cause this stop.

resources.remaining_reservation: 30 days total reserved outside OC for all preparation elapsed, seven-day Jev reservation and measured label throughput; not a promise of 30 days remaining after inventory; stricter actual remaining-clock gate applies
resources.preparation_gate: Retain genuine independent L40/400/complete/full512 evidence and publish envelopes. Locked remeasurement and fit follow resources.binding_resource_stop_rule; both hard counters remain required.
resources.failure: Not testable; no assumed speedup, grid shrink, extra cores or unmeasured memory capacity
resources.inventory_throughput_screen: Before full OC, n_max=300 keyed development sample: 2*2.4*N_reserved/4 *7*900*ln(40)/(3*(n_max-1)) seconds must fit 45 days minus elapsed, seven-day Jev reservation and projected binding-OC wall time. Include dev collection scans in inventory projection; failure is not testable.
resources.product_recovery: Exact stored-pi/draw/point/interval/verdict parity. Effect: locked sizes, M=2000 without binding cap, failure 0, fully annotated, prevalence .20, realised>=.30; >=2000 OC trials with support Wilson lower>=.99 before seeds 169/170/171 support. Null seeds: non-support and nonzero width, not individual coverage.

required_checks: all expected cell and population identities exactly once
eligible counts and both sampling-attempt/trial-execution caps
resources.binding_resource_stop_rule including fixed RSS reserve and one-run maximum-input provenance
final_evaluator_contract.implementation_authority: separate reviewed final evaluator and concrete product harness required before full authority
